content.tagline: Vegan, gentle K-beauty for sensitive skin — a home-aesthetic brand built on healing and soothing care
content.descriptor: LICORNE Cosmetics by Limetree Co., Ltd., a Korean vegan skincare brand: hydration, brightening, PDRN-inspired recovery and soothing dermacare across 29 SKUs
about: LICORNE is a Korean vegan skincare brand by Limetree Co., Ltd. (주식회사 라임트리), based in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province. The name LICORNE means “unicorn” in French; inspired by the legend that a unicorn’s horn can heal, the brand places healing and soothing care at the heart of its philosophy — calming and restoring skin that has become sensitive under external and environmental stress.

Guided by the idea of a “personal prescription for one’s skin,” LICORNE positions itself as a home-aesthetic brand: professional-style care designed for everyday use at home. Its formulas are described by the company as gentle and vegan — built on plant-based ingredients, suitable for sensitive skin, and formulated for mild, low-irritation daily care.

The range spans several directions: vegan hydration (Vegan Cactus and Vegan Rice), brightening (Vegan Jeju Matcha), PDRN-inspired recovery (the Salmon DNA line), soothing dermacare (the Dr. MOSSEA Jinjung line) and targeted premium care (Intensive Repair, Collagen Snail, Vitafill and the Hyaluronic Microshot Patch). As stated by the company, the products carry a vegan certification and are manufactured under CGMP / ISO 22716 quality systems, with registrations declared across a number of export markets.

lines.name: Vegan Cactus & Vegan Rice — vegan hydration
lines.note: Everyday vegan hydration built on cactus and rice extracts: mists, toners, serums, ampoules, lotions, creams, eye care, a sun essence and an enzyme cleanser. Plant-based and formulated for sensitive skin.

lines.name: Vegan Jeju Matcha — brightening
lines.note: A brightening vegan line with Jeju matcha: tone-up cream, wash-off pack and brightening cream.

lines.name: Salmon DNA — PDRN-inspired recovery
lines.note: A PDRN-inspired recovery line (salmon-derived concept): fluid sun, water essence, toning pad and ampoule for firmness and vitality care. Presented as cosmetic care, not a medical product.

lines.name: Dr. MOSSEA Jinjung — soothing dermacare
lines.note: A soothing dermacare sub-line: foaming cleanser, balance toner and balance cream for calming sensitive, reactive skin.

lines.name: Targeted & premium care
lines.note: Collagen Snail, Azulene Derma Cleansing, Glow Vita, Vitafill toning pads and ampoules, the Intensive Repair Double Effector and the Hyaluronic Microshot Patch for concentrated, targeted care.

tech.name: Product customization for the buyer
tech.note: According to the company, LICORNE adapts a product to the buyer’s requirements: not only the packaging and the container, but the formulation itself, including the concentration of individual ingredients. The company gives the example of reducing the hyaluronic acid content at a buyer’s request. Batch size, lead time and the cost of such work are agreed at the deal stage.

tech.name: Vegan, plant-based formulation
tech.note: As stated by the company, formulas are built on plant-based ingredients with a vegan certification, oriented toward mild, low-irritation care for sensitive skin.

tech.name: PDRN-inspired recovery (Salmon DNA)
tech.note: The Salmon DNA line is built on a PDRN-inspired recovery concept, presented by the company as cosmetic care for firmness and vitality — not as a medical or injectable product.

tech.name: Home-aesthetic concept
tech.note: Products are designed for professional-style routines at home — simple, quick daily care — rather than in-clinic procedures.

tech.name: Quality and registrations
tech.note: Manufacturing under CGMP / ISO 22716 and market registrations (MoCRA, CPNP, PMDA, NPRA, EAC, NMPA, TFDA) are declared by the company; copies and per-market status are verified at the deal stage.

content.exportNote: LICORNE's registrations are backed by copies of documents handed to Teranova in August 2026. The European Union holds CPNP notifications for 15 products and CPSR safety reports for 11; Japan, filings for 9 products together with Japanese labels and full ingredient lists. Singapore is notified for 10 items valid until May 2027 and Malaysia for 5 items until November 2027. China holds 6 NMPA filings for imported cosmetics, Thailand 4 FDA registrations, Russia 7 declarations of conformity under TR CU 009/2011, and for the United States the company provided its MoCRA listing. Registrations for Vietnam and the Philippines are marked as expired, and part of the active ones are held by local holders, so transfer to a new partner is checked at the deal stage. From 11 to 23 August 2026 the brand runs its own corner at Hyundai Department Store Pangyo. The delivery basis is FOB Korea.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: MOQ 3,000 units per item (tube-packaged items — 5,000 units)

terms.label: Customization
terms.value: According to the company, products can be adapted for the buyer: packaging and container, as well as the concentration of individual ingredients in the formulation. The terms of such work, including minimum batch and lead time, are agreed at the deal stage.

terms.label: Pricing
terms.value: Indicative FOB prices are published in USD, from about USD 2 to USD 12 per item depending on product and volume. The supplier's price list is issued in KRW and USD; the settlement currency is fixed at the deal stage

terms.label: Registrations
terms.value: Declared across US, EU, Japan, Malaysia, Russia, China and Thailand; per-market status and documents verified at the deal stage

terms.label: Payment and lead time
terms.value: Payment is finalised in the contract. As stated by the company, a customized batch takes a minimum of two months from the moment all details are agreed.

terms.label: Private label
terms.value: As stated by the company, manufacturing under the buyer's own brand is available. In that case the product registration stays with the brand owner, that is, with the buyer.

terms.label: A changed formula and registrations
terms.value: If the formulation is changed for export, re-registration falls to the brand owner: for LICORNE products the company handles it, for private label the buyer does.

terms.label: Marketing materials
terms.value: The company has provided reviews by eighteen international creators and confirmed that secondary-usage rights have been obtained. The list is supplied to a buyer at the deal stage.

content.consentNote: The data and materials are provided by Limetree Co., Ltd. (LICORNE, contact Mi Hyeon Oh) and published with the company’s consent for presentation on the Teranova platform (August 2026). Information on the vegan certification, CGMP / ISO 22716 manufacturing and market registrations is stated by the company and is subject to documentary confirmation at the deal stage; per-market registration status may vary and some registrations may be in progress. Products are positioned as cosmetics for topical use, not as medical devices or medicines.
